summary: grafana.grafana in Ansible 11 rolls up earlier changes: Mimir config check before restart and distributor section support, feature_toggles in the grafana role, alloy_user_groups restored, Alloy role improvements and post-setup healthcheck, and many lint and pylint dependency bumps.
questions: Can I set feature toggles through the grafana role in Ansible 11?
Does the Mimir role support a distributor section?
Does the Alloy role run a healthcheck after setup?

answer_card.title: grafana.grafana changes in Ansible 11
answer_card.answer_md:
Highlights:
- Mimir: config check before restart, and a `distributor` section in the config.
- grafana role: `feature_toggles` support.
- Alloy: `alloy_user_groups` restored, role improvements, post-setup healthcheck.
- Many ansible-lint and pylint bumps.
